_: How the viewer page is built from this directory: by the binary when its relay's routes are made (internal/viewerbuild, from what it embeds) and for the Worker by cloudflare/scripts/build-viewer.mjs. Both read this file and nothing else for the rule, refuse a key or a version they do not know, and a test holds their output byte for byte the same. copy is what is served as it is, each at its path.
